```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

DATA=/home/eval/data

# Per-customer summary over paid orders only.
jq -c '
  [ .[]
    | select(.status == "paid")
    | { customer,
        value: ([ .items[]? | .qty * .price ] | add // 0) } ]
  | group_by(.customer)                       # group_by sorts by customer ascending
  | map({ customer: .[0].customer,
          orders:   length,
          total:    (map(.value) | add) })
  | sort_by([ -.total, .customer ])           # stable: ties keep customer order
  | .[]
  | { customer, orders, total }
' "$DATA/orders.json" > "$DATA/customers.jsonl"

# SKU with the largest total quantity across paid orders.
jq -r '
  [ .[]
    | select(.status == "paid")
    | .items[]?
    | { sku, qty } ]
  | group_by(.sku)
  | map({ sku: .[0].sku, qty: (map(.qty) | add) })
  | sort_by([ -.qty, .sku ])
  | .[0]
  | "\(.sku) \(.qty)"
' "$DATA/orders.json" > "$DATA/top_sku.txt"

exit 0
```
